name: the package manifests
record: gandr check, in the directory of each manifest

name: the manifest of the root workspace
reason: the walk that finds the standard library reads the members of this manifest, and it never runs `std` to find `std`

name: the features database
record: none: the file has 0 bytes, and no program of the tree writes it

name: the locks of cargo
reason: cargo reads the lock before a program of the tree runs, and a build with no lock is not the same build two times

name: the locks of the tools
reason: mise and aube read the lock before a program of the tree runs, and an install with no lock is not the same install two times

name: the lock of the fixture workspace
reason: it is the subject of the fixture: a resolve that finds a different address is the refusal that the fixture shows

name: the module map of std
reason: a person writes each row, and no program can compute it

name: the crate table
reason: a person writes one row for each crate, and no program can compute it

name: the ledgers that a person writes
reason: a person writes each row, and a task puts the rows in order. `ledger:stamp` writes the column `since` of `ledger/features.sql`

name: the mutation lists
reason: each list is the data of one mutation run, which builds the crate one time for each mutant, and no later change writes it

name: the debug traces of {crate}
reason: each trace is the record of one run of a test under the debugger, and no later change writes it
